name: Lcs Precision Molding
old_description: : LCS can help take your project from design phase into full scale production.  Our engineering department can assist with part design, prototyping, resin selection,  and source the most cost effective tooling available through both domestic and Asian toolmaking partnerships.  Our factory specializes in cost effective short run manufacturing, part assembly, min/max stocking programs, short lead times and consistent OTD record of >95%.
about:
LCS Precision Molding, Inc. operates from Waterville, Minnesota, where it has provided custom plastic injection molding for more than 50 years. The company began as a small molding operation created to meet a specific customer need and grew from a single machine into a full-service manufacturer with 15 presses and end-to-end project support.

The company runs 15 injection molding presses with clamping forces from 22 to 400 tons and shot capacities up to 27 ounces. In-house engineering assists with part design, resin selection, and design-for-manufacturing feedback, while mold development is coordinated through domestic and international tooling partners. Secondary operations include assembly, custom packaging, kitting, stocking programs, and specialized shipping, allowing LCS to handle short-run orders as well as long-term production programs.

LCS serves industries such as fenestration, motorsports, recreational products, furniture, electronics, water filtration, retail infrastructure, and specialized industrial applications. Customers range from OEMs needing precision housings and components to manufacturers of building products, outdoor equipment, and fluid-handling systems.

LCS emphasizes a one-partner approach from concept through delivery, backed by ISO 9001:2015 certification and an on-time delivery record exceeding 95 percent. The company highlights flexible production capacity, personalized project management, and U.S.-based manufacturing with access to both domestic and overseas tooling resources as key differentiators.
